 Hon'Ble Sri Justice C.V.Bhaskar Reddy
 Writ Petition No.25292 of 2024
Order:
This Writ Petition is filed declaring the action of the respondents in proceeding with the widening of
the existing National Highway 65 from 100 feet to 200 feet road from Hyderabad to Mumbai
without

2. The case of the petitioners that they are the owners and possessors of various extents of the agricultural lands in various survey numbers situated at Rudraram Village, Patancheru Mandal,
Sangareddy District.

It is the further case of the petitioners that their names were recorded as pattadars in the revenue records and pattadar pass books and title deeds have been issued as per the provisions of the Telangana Rights CVBR, J Wp_25292_2024 in Land and Pattadar Pass Books Act,
1971 and they are also receiving rythu bandhu investment subsidy for cultivation of their lands.

sentences.text:
It is the further case of the petitioners that the respondents are making efforts to dispossess them from their lands for expansion of existing 100 feet National Highway 65 from Hyderabad to Mumbai,
without initiating proceedings under the provisions of the Act, 2013 or without conducting any survey of the lands which are affected in the road widening.
3.

Heard Sri Jalli Kanakaiah, learned Senior Counsel representing Sri Narendar Jalli, learned counsel for the petitioners, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue appearing for respondent Nos.1, 4 to 6 and Sri M. Ramu, learned Standing Counsel for NHAI appearing for respondent Nos.2 and 3.
4.
It is the case of the petitioners that they are the owners and possessors of various extents of lands situated in various survey numbers at Rudraram Village, Patancheru Mandal, Sangareddy District.
It is further case of the petitioners that their lands are abutting to the National Highway leading from Hyderabad to Mumbai.

Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue has not disputed that they have taken up road CVBR, J Wp_25292_2024 widening/expansion of the existing 100 feet National Highway No.65 leading from Hyderabad to Mumbay.

Since it is stated that the petitioners'
lands were abutting to the National Highway, if the lands are in any way affected in the work taken up by the respondents for expansion/formation/renovation of existing 100 feet National Highway No.65 and if the lands of the petitioners are required for the aforesaid purpose
, the respondents are directed to follow due procedure in accordance with law.
5. With the above observations, the writ petition is disposed of.
